summary: Full backend + frontend regression (iteration 2). All 17 pytest backend tests pass. Both critical bugs from iteration_1 are fixed: (1) POST /api/reports now returns 200 with report_id DF-2026-XX-#### and tracking_code TRK-##### (verified end-to-end via UI: DF-2026-TN-9937 / TRK-83951 rendered in submission-success-modal). (2) POST /api/voice/structure returns REAL Gemini translation and structuring (Tamil demo phrase 'குடிநீரில் சாக்கடை நாற்றம்...' produced genuine English translation 'There is a severe sewage smell in the drinking water, and it is coming out yellow.' — no fallback prefix). All backend endpoints (health, list/filters/search/single-get on reports, tracking valid/invalid_code_400/unknown_id_404, PATCH status + timeline append, PATCH moderate, POST officer-ai-summary, advisories GET/POST, clusters, analytics, audit-logs, demo-users) verified. Frontend mobile flows (splash 3D + 5-language selector + Launch, language switching English<->Tamil, role switcher Citizen/Officer/Admin dashboards, track-report with sample TN button, map<->list toggle with 7 pins/7 list items, voice-assistant modal with Gemini structuring, citizen report submission end-to-end) all pass on 390x844 viewport.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' — expected on Expo web preview but confirm useNativeDriver:false is passed on web or split platform-specific code. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/Splash3DAnimation.tsx

Multiple console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Migrate shadow* -> boxShadow and pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx and children components with shadow styles.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Migrate deprecated React Native web style props: shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents (console warnings only, non-blocking).
OPTIONAL: On web, pass useNativeDriver:false or gate animations by Platform.OS to silence 'RCTAnimation missing' warning in splash/other Animated code.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx is a single ~2400 line file. Recommend splitting into feature screens (Home, Report, Track, Map, Operations) and hooks to keep files <700 lines per code review guidelines.
No auth enforcement on PATCH /reports/{id}/status, /moderate, POST /advisories, POST /seed — acceptable for demo but must be hardened before production.
POST /api/seed is publicly callable and wipes all reports/advisories/clusters/audit_logs — consider guarding by an admin token or env flag.
seed_data_creation: Created two TEST_-prefixed reports (Kerala TEST_Ward + Tamil Nadu TEST_Ward) and one TEST_ advisory during pytest + UI runs. All prefixed with TEST_ for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Splash requires clicking [data-testid=splash-enter-app-btn] before root renders. Demo tracking DF-2026-TN-4821 / TRK-89324 works. Role switcher: [data-testid=header-role-switcher-btn] -> select-role-{citizen|officer|admin}-btn. Voice modal demo-phrase-btn-0 click AUTO-TRIGGERS Gemini analyze (analyze-transcript-btn is hidden while isAnalyzing) — wait for [data-testid=gemini-structured-card] instead of clicking analyze after demo phrase.
rca_of_issue: Both bugs from iteration_1 confirmed fixed. (1) 'import uuid' now present at /app/backend/server.py line 2 — report creation no longer NameErrors. (2) load_dotenv is called inside gemini_service at call time and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY reads at call time — verified via Tamil transcript returning real English translation rather than the '[AI Assisted] Citizen reported:' rule-based fallback prefix.
